scope: all eight fresh families, eight-word pools and selected quartet alternatives in full-puzzle context; semantic novelty against retained category registry

new-01-g0.note: All eight are verbs for assuming a bodily position.

new-01-g1.note: All eight mean voicing dissatisfaction; this differs from retained criticism directed at a target.

new-01-g3.note: All eight describe struggling or performing clumsily.

new-02-g0.note: All eight name organisms used in biological research; several are broad classes rather than species.

new-02-g1.note: All eight are sweet baked goods.

new-02-g2.note: All eight can name keepsakes or objects valued as reminders; TOKEN uses its memento sense rather than its computing sense.

new-02-g3.note: All eight are restaurant job roles.

new-03-g0.note: All eight are exact programming-language names.

new-03-g1.note: All eight form established CITY names or nicknames; FORBIDDEN CITY is a palace complex.

new-03-g2.note: All eight are complete recognizable character names from Rebecca Sugar's Steven Universe; RUBY, EMERALD and SAPPHIRE elsewhere in this family are also characters.

new-03-g3.note: All eight form familiar BLUE color names.

new-04-g0.note: All eight complete exact established comic-character names ending MAN, with conventional hyphenation allowed.

new-04-g1.note: All eight name organized social events.

new-04-g2.note: All eight are traditional wedding-anniversary materials, with customary regional variation.

new-04-g3.note: All eight name basic chemicals or base-related chemical classes.

new-05-g0.note: All eight can mean moving or proceeding quickly.

new-05-g1.note: All eight contain PH pronounced as the F sound.

new-05-g2.note: All eight concern tournament arrangement or progression.

new-05-g3.note: All eight can mean making or becoming smaller in amount.

new-06-g0.note: All eight form established SIZE expressions, with standard hyphenation allowed.

new-06-g1.note: All eight can mean deceiving or cheating.

new-06-g2.note: All eight can name property or legal arrangements securing an obligation; PAWN uses its pledged-property noun sense.

new-06-g3.note: All eight are Christian clergy titles or roles.

new-07-g0.note: All eight form ordinary DRAWER expressions; this descriptor category also admits several words from the compartment pool.

new-07-g1.note: All eight form ordinary COMPARTMENT expressions; broad container descriptors produce cross-memberships with the drawer pool.

new-07-g2.note: All eight end with a doubled consonant; a literal spelling connection distinct from retained phonetic wordplay.

new-07-g3.note: All eight can mean catching or taking into custody.

new-08-g1.note: All eight are gases, charcoal or woods used to fuel barbecues; wood species here express fuel use rather than the retained tree-name relation.

new-08-g2.note: All eight can denote writing on documents, especially signatures or endorsements; this broader label truthfully includes INSCRIBE.

new-08-g3.note: All eight form familiar IN phrasal verbs; SIGN and INK also fit.
